title: HMAC Final returns WC_HW_E (not CRYPTOCB_UNAVAILABLE) on hardware INIT failure
description: What is correct and why: crypto2dev_hmac() Final path (port.c:1066-1075): when INIT ioctl fails at Final time, the port returns WC_HW_E, not CRYPTOCB_UNAVAILABLE. The comment explains: Update calls already returned 0 (claimed), so wolfSSL's software HMAC state has no accumulated data. A software fallback Final would compute HMAC over empty input — a silent authentication bypass that produces a wrong MAC with no error. Returning WC_HW_E surfaces a hard failure. A future contributor who sees 'we could fallback gracefully here' and changes this to CRYPTOCB_UNAVAILABLE would introduce a subtle MAC bypass: the caller gets 0 (success) but the MAC is wrong.
